zh-HK: PDF QR Code 新增 Payment Methods、WhatsApp、PayMe 及 FPS 四種清晰用途卡片，加入品牌圖示、掃描提示及穩定中文渲染
Invoice／Proforma Invoice 統一付款到期日、Billing Address、隱藏產品圖片、總計與 QR Code 版面規則
手機 PDF 匯出改用 Noto Sans HK subset 字型、非阻塞 base64 轉換及逾時保護，並新增經資源稽核的 deploy 建置流程
付款方法指引、PayMe 商戶連結及 FPS 商戶資料改由 version.json 遙距更新，無需等待完整平台部署
en: PDF QR codes now use clear Payment Methods, WhatsApp, PayMe, and FPS purpose cards with brand marks, scan guidance, and reliable Chinese rendering
Invoice and Proforma Invoice exports now share payment due-date, Billing Address, hidden-product-image, totals, and QR layout rules
Mobile PDF export now uses Noto Sans HK subset fonts, non-blocking base64 conversion, timeout protection, and an audited deploy build
Payment guide, PayMe merchant, and FPS merchant details can now be updated remotely through version.json without waiting for a full app deployment
